title: HIRAETH -The End of the Journey-
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Junior high student Mika, grieving her best friend, attempts suicide to join her in death. Instead she falls in with an unnamed, dying god traveling to Yomi, the Shinto land of the dead, and Hibino, an immortal man who follows the god hoping to learn how to end his own life. The three ride a motorbike across Japan toward the entrance to Yomi in Shimane, a three-volume drama about grief and the wish to die.
life_message: Grief and the wish to die are met with companionship on the road, and the journey itself questions whether death is the end one seeks.
